company.description:
Charityvest is a personal charitable giving fund that allows individuals to donate to US nonprofits from one tax-deductible account. The charitable giving platform enables anyone to create a Donor-Advised Fund or charitable giving account. The platform helps companies automatically match their employees' charitable giving with smart budgets and compliance tools. 

It was founded in 2019 and is based in Atlanta, Georgia.

caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.
